name: singlet_deconvolution_bulk_celltype_specific_expression
title: Cell-type-specific expression per bulk sample
description: Estimates, for each bulk sample, the expression profile of every cell type or cell state and the fraction each contributes, using a BayesPrism-style Bayesian allocation model against a labelled single-cell reference. Use it when per-sample, per-type expression is needed; for fractions alone use the proportion task. Requires raw non-negative counts for bulk and reference, with no scaling. Writes posterior fractions, their standard deviations and per-type profiles; stochastic through seed.

dataset.description: Bulk dataset handle (.singlet path or URI) with raw counts in bulk/layers/counts, genes by samples.

reference.description: Labelled single-cell reference: its dataset handle and label keys.

dataset.description: Reference dataset handle with raw counts in layers/counts.

cell_type_key.description: obs column with cell-type labels; undefined and mixed labels are dropped.

cell_state_key.description: Optional obs column with cell-state labels; null uses cell types only.

method.description: Estimation method. bayesprism is the only value offered, and it is the default.

report_min_fraction.description: Report per-type profiles only for types whose estimated fraction is at least this value.

bayesprism.description: Options for the bayesprism method: Gibbs sampling and reference update.

chain_length.description: Gibbs chain length C; retained draws T = ceil((C - burn_in) / thinning).

burn_in.description: Initial Gibbs draws discarded; must be below chain_length.

thinning.description: Keep every thinning-th draw after burn-in.

alpha.description: Dirichlet prior on fractions; raised to at least 1 when pseudo_min is 0.

pseudo_min.description: Floor added to reference profile probabilities in rows containing zeros.

optimizer.description: Optimiser for the reference update: MAP with log-normal prior, or MLE.

sigma.description: Hyper-parameter of the MAP log-normal prior; ignored by MLE.

maxit.description: Maximum optimiser iterations for the reference update.

update_reference.description: Update the reference and repeat sampling; profiles still come from the initial posterior.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for Gibbs draws; identical inputs and seed reproduce outputs.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without computing profiles.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. uns/<name>/theta_mean. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed runs: n_samples, n_types, shared_genes, retained_draws, types_reported, reference_updated, dropped_labels.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
